title: tc-smart-recommendation
description: A suggestion with a confidence signal, alternatives and one-click accept and undo.

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

options.description: The first entry is the recommendation, the rest are offered as alternatives. A new set starts over

value.description: Id of the option on show; empty shows the recommendation

accepted.description: Id of the accepted option, or null

label.description: Short name, used in the accept button, e.g. "Incremental sync"

reason.description: One sentence why – text, or an element (cloned)
